description: paddock tracks Claude Code sessions in its terminals. Each hook runs `paddock hook <event>` if paddock is on PATH, and does nothing otherwise.

hooks.command: command -v paddock >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; export PADDOCK_HOOK_SOURCE=plugin; exec paddock hook SessionStart >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v paddock >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; export PADDOCK_HOOK_SOURCE=plugin; exec paddock hook UserPromptSubmit >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v paddock >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; export PADDOCK_HOOK_SOURCE=plugin; exec paddock hook PostToolUse >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v paddock >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; export PADDOCK_HOOK_SOURCE=plugin; exec paddock hook PreCompact >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v paddock >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; export PADDOCK_HOOK_SOURCE=plugin; exec paddock hook PermissionRequest >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v paddock >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; export PADDOCK_HOOK_SOURCE=plugin; exec paddock hook Notification >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v paddock >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; export PADDOCK_HOOK_SOURCE=plugin; exec paddock hook Stop >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v paddock >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; export PADDOCK_HOOK_SOURCE=plugin; exec paddock hook SessionEnd >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v paddock >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; export PADDOCK_HOOK_SOURCE=plugin; exec paddock hook SubagentStart >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v paddock >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; export PADDOCK_HOOK_SOURCE=plugin; exec paddock hook SubagentStop >/dev/null 2>&1
